text: Late-window TWAP backtest (twapLateBacktest.py, 2,791 markets 2026-08-26..09-25, SELECT/VALIDATE split 09-11): buying the TWAP-aware leader in the last 30-60 s does NOT hold up. With realism guards (price >= 0.40, print <= 5 s old, +1c): VALIDATE ROI +3.5% [CI -7.3%, +13.6%] n=99 at 2 s latency, +2.9% [-4.3, +11.0] at 1 s, +6.4% [-11.6, +22.2] at 5 s; the no-signal favourite baseline scores about the same (+4.4% / -1.4% / +2.4%); +2c cost leaves ~+1%. The +80% SELECT figure without guards was cheap stale prints (lottery tickets). The 2-day tape lead (+16%) did not replicate. Chainlink spot proxy (Binance - TWAP-anchored basis) checked on the tape: leader agrees 99.1%, |err| median $2.56. Conclusion: the late-window market already prices the partly-written TWAP; no strategy change.

Why v2 trades rarely, and can it trade more at a high win rate (2026-09-26). Journal: v1 took 20-44 trades/day, v2 10-16, and 4 in the 16 h after the PTB fix; the ML gate conf>=0.65 (p>=0.825) was sized for the overconfident v1 and v2 is calibrated, so it rarely clears it (decision trail since the fix: ml_conf holds 55% of ENTER signals, entry_ceiling 35% - relaxing that cap buys 82c favourites that win 73.5% and lose -11%). ruleSearch.py: 211 variants on 3,707 fresh-price markets, chosen on SELECT, judged once on VALIDATE - none trades >=1.5x with total PnL >= CURRENT; the pick (conf>=0.45) makes +12.9 vs +16.9 (paired CI [-18.1, +10.0]). twapModelStudy.py: TWAP-correct features add nothing in the 2-12 min window (the market prices them; v2 adds nothing beyond price either); ~8% Brier skill only in the last 15-60 s, where a rule is not distinguishable from buying the favourite and moves with 1-2c of fill. Decision: keep CURRENT and the model; score the edge-bypass variant (0.20 at edge>=12%) forward in decisionTrailStudy section (e); record the TWAP arithmetic (tp/tz/dr) on tape d lines for a re-test on real asks.

Gates softened 2026-09-26 (operator asked to soften the filters and keep forward-testing the edge bypass). Declared family: 2 ML gates (live 0.65/0.45@15%, bypass 0.65/0.20@12%) x 5 btc_dist multipliers (1, .75, .5, .25, 0) on the 3,707-market fresh-price set; chosen by SELECT total PnL = bypass + btc_dist x0.25 (SELECT n=205, +7.15%, +14.66). VALIDATE judged once: n=466 (20.5/day vs 8.5), WR 63.5%, paid 58.1c, ROI +8.60% CI [+2.9, +14.3], PnL +40.07 vs CURRENT +16.92; cost +2c +6.78% [+1.3, +12.6], +3c +5.0% [-0.6, +10.9]; neighbours (bypass .10/.15, relaxed .30) all positive; top-5 trades 4.72 of 40.07; 70% of 23 days profitable; MC 500 trades P(loss) 0.0%, max DD p95 23.8%. btc_dist softening alone with the live gate lowers PnL (16.9 -> 12.4). Shipped as env: FILTER_ML_CONF_RELAXED=0.20, FILTER_HIGH_EDGE_BYPASS=0.10 (bot edge is ~2pp below the backtest's), FILTER_BTC_DIST_MIN_PCT=0.01. Tape forward tests of the bypass so far: +31.9% (n=10 added), +17.9% (n=7 added).
